instruction.name: xvperm.w
instruction.description: Permute 32-bit elements across the whole 256-bit vector.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.15 cycles. Measured CPI 0.2687; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LASX vector instruction measured on LA664. Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
